segments.text: BEtake your self to God in a course of earnest consta•t Prayer: Confess and lament your former lives, and beg his grace to illuminate and Convert you. Beseech him to pardon what is past, and to give you his Spirit, and change your hearts and lives, and lead you in his waies, and save you from temptations. And ply this work daily and be not weary of it.
